audit.whatIsWrong: The entry's central premise is backwards. early says 'his Q out-ranges your 550 cast range', late says 'Once his Q is maxed he simply out-ranges you', and spikes[3], whys[0], whys[2], whys[6], wants.foe[0] and wants.you[2] all repeat it. It also treats 550 as Mel's cast range.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb casts at 850. Radiant Volley casts at 950 and Solar Snare at 1000. Mel out-ranges his Q by a hundred units and always has — 550 is her basic-attack range, not her cast range, and comparing his spell to her auto range produced the wrong conclusion in seven strings. What genuinely reaches past her is Satchel Charge at 1000, Hexplosive Minefield at 900 and Mega Inferno Bomb at 5000. This inverts the lane plan: the page told her to avoid the poke war she wins and said nothing about the siege she actually loses.
audit.corrected: Real cast ranges throughout: 950 versus 850 on the Q duel, with Satchel Charge's 1000, Hexplosive Minefield's 900 and Mega Inferno Bomb's 5000 named as the things that do out-reach her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill six times then Mel at 2+ items, directly above a why and a late paragraph that both say Ziggs reclaims the lane as the scaling artillery.
audit.why: Whatever the sample says — and it is only 8 games — the entry's own prose is unambiguous that the last stage is his, and giving Mel a 7/10 there contradicts it. His Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70 at 5000 range and Hexplosive Minefield clears waves she has to volley down; that is a siege she cannot answer with one root and no dash.
audit.corrected: win[6] and phases[6].side now read Ziggs, with phases[6].rating 7/10 to 4/10. The six Skill stages stand — this is a genuine mirror-match poke lane and nothing in the data moves them. No mirror file exists (audits/top/ziggs__mel.json), so this side sets the direction.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere in the content layer, and spikes[3] pinned the swing on 'once his Q is maxed'.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 — maxing it changes the cadence, not the reach, so a range-based spike at level 9 was never real. The spikes that are real are Satchel Charge's 20/18/16/14/12 downtime and Mega Inferno Bomb at 120/95/70.
audit.corrected: spikes[3], mid and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the actual timers and the actual reach.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d said Rebuttal is 'gone for twenty seconds'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. In a lane whose whole plan is catching a projectile with it, an 18-second understatement of its downtime is the error that decides trades.
audit.corrected: 38s at rank 1 written into tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hexplosive Minefield is described only as something to bait, with no mechanic attached.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.' The falloff is the counterplay — walking straight through the field costs far less than picking a way around it, and it is on a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: mid gives the 16s timer and the field is treated as something to cross rather than freeze in front of.

edits.before: Two artillery mages, but his Q out-ranges your 550 cast range, so don't try to win a pure poke war — you'll lose the trade math every time he lands a bomb. Your edge is Solar Snare: at level 2 with Q + E up, the instant he plants his feet to wind up a bomb, root him and follow with an empowered auto to stack Overwhelm. Watch for his W — if you stand in the bomb it knocks you back out of your own range and resets the trade in his favor.
edits.after: Two artillery mages, and the range war is yours, not his: Radiant Volley casts at 950 against Bouncing Bomb's 850, so poke first and step back. Your other edge is Solar Snare at 1000 — the instant he plants his feet to wind up a bomb, root him and follow with an empowered auto to stack Overwhelm. Watch Satchel Charge, 1000 range on 20s at rank 1, because it knocks you back out of your own range and resets the trade in his favour.

edits.before: This is your best window, but it's narrow. Rebuttal is the swing tool — time the wall to eat his Q bomb mid-flight and reflect it as your own damage, which flips a single exchange entirely. At 6, Golden Eclipse pays off all the Overwhelm you've stacked from Q and autos, so a clean poke sequence into R can chunk or execute him from across the lane. Bait his E minefield onto the wave, then walk the safe lane and root him when his knockback W is down.
edits.after: This is your best window, but it's narrow. Rebuttal is the swing tool — 38s at rank 1, and Bouncing Bomb is a thrown projectile, so catching one mid-flight flips a whole exchange. At 6, Golden Eclipse pays off all the Overwhelm you've stacked from Q and autos, so a clean poke sequence into R can chunk or execute him from across the lane. Walk straight through Hexplosive Minefield (16s) rather than around it, and root him while Satchel Charge is down.

edits.before: Once his Q is maxed he simply out-ranges you — he pokes you off the wave and sieges your tower from a distance your 550 range can't punish, and you have no dash to close it. Your passive scales forever, but in a raw poke duel his single longer-range bomb beats your need to stack first. Stop trying to 1v1 the siege: rotate, look for Solar Snare picks in the river or on a flank, and let R finish anyone your team catches rather than soloing the artillery war.
edits.after: He does not out-range your Q — 850 against your 950 — but he does out-siege you: Hexplosive Minefield clears the waves you have to volley down, and Mega Inferno Bomb lands from 5000 on a 120/95/70 timer you cannot contest. You have no dash and one root. Stop trying to 1v1 the siege: rotate, look for Solar Snare picks in the river or on a flank, and let R finish anyone your team catches rather than soloing the artillery war.

notes: SAMPLE WARNING: MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.ziggs is 8 games behind the 37.5% figure — three losses in eight. I did not touch diff (EVEN), diffRating (5.5/10) or carryRating on that basis, and win[6] was flipped on the strength of the entry's own late-game prose and the ability ranges, not on the win rate. Kit flag misfire: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json tags Satchel Charge with 'percentHealth', but Riot's text has no percent-health damage — the flag is almost certainly picking up the turret-hexplode clause. champ-data/_kits/_missing/mel.json raises 'Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge)' from that same flag, so I wrote nothing from it. The reflect claims in this entry are the one place in my whole slice where reflection is well founded: Riot's own text calls Bouncing Bomb a thrown bouncing bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb a hurled bomb, and both carry the projectile flag consistently with the description. Unverified and left alone: whether Bouncing Bomb's bounces extend its effective reach past the 850 cast range — that is the only way the page's original 'he out-ranges you' claim could have been partly true, and neither file quantifies it.
